reviews.content: 이 작가는 너무 질질끌고 꼬이고  필력도 내용도 좋은데   진전이넘 느리고 여주남주 탐색하다가 막판에찔금진전에 으 스트레스 하차

I don’t know why this webnovel get this high rate. The female lead is so dumb. The story is so slow & boring. Even the “hot” scenes aren’t hot at all. I usually enjoy slow-paced stories, but this one completely drained my patience because of how boring it is.
This story progresses very slowly because of unnecessary and unimportant elements.
The inner monologue is too long—even during conversations between characters. After character A says something, you have to go through tons of paragraphs just to get a response from character B.
I stopped reading around chapter 150 because I just couldn’t continue anymore. It felt like a complete waste of my time and my money.

그림체에 홀려서 100회까지 읽었는데
여주는 진짜 너무 소심하고 생각을 안하고 뭔가 대책이 있겠지 하는데 걍 대책없음 빙의 설정도 이해 안됨ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 빙의 했으면 뭘 해야하는데 하는거 남주 의지하기~ 남주 따라 다니기~ 남주한테 구걸하기~ 원작 여주 한테 이어줘야지 하고 낼름 남주 몸 취함 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
